player_prompt.intro:
Niwe Mwina {player_id} mu {num_rounds}-round ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kila round, tashani nambari kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Pamoja na mashauri yote, lengo ni (2/3)x(wastani wa mashauri yote),
na mwina ambaye tashani lake ni karibu na lengo anashinda round hiyo.
Jibu na tashani yako kwa fomu '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid format; please submit your guess as “[<number>]”.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Icipimo cifwile ukuba pa kati ka {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.
